parsed.name: ensemble_two_lens_biotech_power
parsed.strategy: Only names at least two independent lenses would pick. Biotech sleeve: dated Q4-2026 PDUFAs where revision flow is net-positive (VRTX, MRK, GILD, AGIO, COGT, BBIO) - the catalyst calendar plus analyst-flow lens agree. Power sleeve: AI electricity bottleneck names with both order momentum and positive revisions (CEG, GEV, NVT, CCJ, LEU). Semis sleeve: Asia supply-chain gatekeepers with confirmed earnings dates and net raises (ASML, TSM, MU, NVDA). I am wrong if a single macro shock - hyperscaler capex digestion, a China export-control headline, or a cluster of PDUFA CRLs - hits the correlated sleeves at once, or if the CRL tail (median -13.7% on the day) lands on two or more biotech names.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY net of costs by holding only names two or more independent lenses would select.
